title: Compact troubleshooting cards and animated retry affordances for Quickstart
creator: Ava Kim
description: Produce a set of compact, reusable troubleshooting UI cards and micro-animations for the Quickstart flow that explain common runtime errors (rate limits, timeouts, transient network errors) and recommended user actions (automatic retry, exponential backoff, contact support). Deliverables: 1) Figma source file with components and variants for card headers, body microcopy, CTA states (retry, wait, open docs, contact support) and small inline illustrations; 2) Exported PNG/SVG assets for docs and product screenshots (mobile and desktop sizes); 3) Short Lottie prototype for 'retry animation' showing progressive backoff with visual affordance; 4) Updated quickstart docs screenshots with error-state overlays for the new Console release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains component variants: rate-limit, timeout, retry-suggested, persistent-failure
Microcopy reviewed and signed off by PM and support (no legal wording required)
PNG/SVG exports in documentation sizes (800x480, 1200x720, 320x180) uploaded to Drive and referenced in PR
Lottie JSON prototype playable in docs page and Console dev env
Design tokens and color contrast meet accessibility AA for text and icons
Engineering can consume components by mapping 3 states (soft fail, retrying, hard fail) to props
comments: 2026-03-01 Ava Kim: Kickoff — scoped to Quickstart flow only. Prioritize rate-limit, timeout, and network retries. PM aligned on tone: polite, actionable, low-friction.

2026-03-03 Miguel Ortega: Exploration posted in Figma. Two visual directions: (A) compact card with small illustration + single CTA; (B) inline banner with progressive context. Requesting dev input on animation budget.
2026-03-05 Priya Desai (PM): Prefer compact cards (A) for docs, inline banners for Console. Microcopy: change 'Try again' -> 'Retry now' for clarity. Add support link option for enterprise customers.

2026-03-07 Daniel Park (Engineering): Confirmed Lottie approach is acceptable; we need a lightweight SVG fallback for Restricted mode. Also noted Console has a 120px height constraint for the quickstart pane.
2026-03-09 Design review: Accessibility pass done. Color contrast adjusted for buttons. Added keyboard focus states for retry interaction.
2026-03-10 QA note: Exported PNG at 800x480 looks cramped — increased padding and reduced icon scale. Updated files uploaded to Drive.
2026-03-11 Miguel Ortega: PR created linking assets and new doc screenshots — GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
2026-03-12 Ava Kim: In Review — asking Docs and Support for final sign-off. If no blocking feedback by 2026-03-16, mark Done and merge release branch.
